meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后,Emacs 被加为聊天频道。你可以直接在 Emacs 里打开对话或发送 org 内容,收到的回复会显示在缓冲区或写回 org 文件。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 的聊天缓冲区中发送消息,或用 nanoclaw-org-send 发送当前标题/选中区域时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Emacs is added as a chat channel. You can open a conversation in Emacs or send org content; replies appear in the buffer or are written back as child headings in your org file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you send a message in the Emacs chat buffer, or when you send the current heading/region with nanoclaw-org-send.

say_en.note: Sent in the chat buffer; reply appears there.

Select a region in org, then send it.
